verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered automation in the evidence is a single built-in behavior: auto-renew on expiration, enabled by default and toggleable per domain. A Registrar API exists for scripting domain management externally, but nothing shows user-defined rules, triggers, webhooks or event notifications. missing for 10: user-definable event rules, configurable triggers/conditions, webhooks or event notifications, documented action chaining, independent corroboration
